description: This source file implements functions for encoding and decoding variable-length integers (varints), which are used for efficient serialization. It includes functions 'decode_varint' to read a varint from a buffer and 'encode_varint' to write a varint into a buffer.

methods.name: uint64_t decode_varint(const unsigned char ** bufp)
